## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status shows a 7-character revision while history and completion output show 12 characters, so the status line does not match the identifier its docstring promises. This should be fixed before merge.

## Changes
The pull request adds `status(revision, attempt)` and `attempt_label(attempt)` to `app/display.py`, which build a `Running: <revision> (attempt N)` line. It also adds tests for both helpers in `tests/test_display.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the 12-character revision in status, as history does — For the test's `REVISION`, `status` prints `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)`, but `history` prints `History: 0123456789ab`. The docstring at line 13 says status uses "the same identifier as history", but `revision[:7]` differs from the `revision[:12]` at lines 5 and 9. — Operators cannot match a running deployment's status line against its history or completion entries by revision. — Fix: Use `revision[:12]`, and change `test_running_status_contains_attempt` in `tests/test_display.py:11` to assert the full expected string, because the current `startswith`/`endswith` checks pass at either length.
